BiblicalUsage: These is a word that points at men standing right there, and Daniel's story uses it at the moment of accusation. In Daniel 3:12 the Chaldeans say, there are certain Jews whom thou hast set over the affairs of Babylon, these men have not regarded thee, in Daniel 3:13 Nebuchadnezzar in rage commands them to bring these men, and in Daniel 6:11 the men assemble and find Daniel praying before his God.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the pointing finger is the heart of the story: these men would not bow, and the king could not make them.
RelatedEvents: Daniel in the Lions' Den; Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego in the Fiery Furnace
